Name: Sweet Lolita Furniture for Custom Furniture and Alternative Textures
Author: lumiepop
Description:
I created this today out of a sudden burst of motivation and wanting to bring my love of lolita fashion to my favorite game. This is meant for a small niche of people in the Jfashion community, but I hope that other people will enjoy its cuteness as well, without knowing much about it.

Right now, there are 10 items. If you have any lolita fashion-related suggestions for me to add in as furniture, please leave a comment!

For those who want to learn about lolita fashion, here are some resources:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lolita_fashion
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angelic_Pretty

All furniture is based on real items.

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/134036113]Koumiki[/url] for kindly converting my mod to AT and adding previews and an instructional txt file. I appreciate the help so much!

♡♡♡
